modo.rodaCurta: In a circle: one open rule, the same for everyone
modo.chegadaCurta: Order of arrival: newest to oldest

porque.avisoRegra: At the top because it is a notice pinned by moderation.
porque.atoRegra: At the top because the date is within the next {horas} hours.
porque.ajudouRegra: Comes first in the block because the person who asked marked someone else's answer as the one that helped, in a conversation with {ajudou_piso} or more people answering.
porque.interesseRegra: Comes first in the block because it matches an interest you marked on this device.

fim.regraAcabou: From here back, order of arrival
fim.regraAcabouTexto: The rule arranges the last {dias} days. Anything older comes newest to oldest.

vazio.linha: Nothing in this timeline for now. The filter is shown below: check that it is what you wanted.
vazio.temas: You do not follow any #topic yet. Open a topic and tap Follow, or pick one of the rising topics.

fora.criterio: The first ones by the same rule as the timeline. Never by likes.
fora.guardado: The time of your last visit stays only on this device.
fora.nada: Nothing new since your last visit.

alta.criterio: #topics used by {piso} or more people in the last {horas} hours, and by more people than in the {horas} hours before.
alta.igual: The list is the same for everyone. It shows no number, only the range.
alta.nada: No topic is growing right now. Come back later.

linhas.chamada: Timelines made of open filters. You choose what goes in; nobody chooses for you.
linhas.aparelho: Your timelines are kept only on this device. The server receives the filter when it searches and does not keep it.
linhas.prontaCidadeTexto: Calls and actions in the city you type. It is the city written in the call, never the position of the device.
linhas.prontaNucleosTexto: Only what was posted in the cells you belong to.
linhas.prontaEstudoTexto: Only the subject communities: questions, summaries and exercises.
linhas.prontaTemaTexto: Only posts with the #topics you type.
linhas.nomeAjuda: Up to {n} characters. It shows in the Home bar.
linhas.cidadeAjuda: Write it as it appears in the calls: "Recife", "São Paulo".
linhas.tagsAjuda: Up to 10. The post needs at least one.
linhas.nenhuma: You have not built any timeline yet.
linhas.criada: Timeline created. It is already in the Home bar.
linhas.criadaSemBarra: Timeline created. The Home bar is full ({n}): remove one to add this.

erros.nome: Give the timeline a name, up to {n} characters.
erros.muitas: Up to {n} timelines fit. Delete one to create another.
erros.barraCheia: Up to {n} timelines fit in the bar. Remove one first.
erros.vazia: This timeline filters nothing: it would be the Everything tab again. Choose at least one filter.
erros.repetida: There is already a timeline with that name.
erros.tags: Type at least one #topic (letters, numbers and _).

linhas.temasSeguidosTexto: Following a #topic is keeping up with the subject without following people. Nobody sees the topics you follow.
linhas.temaInvalido: A #topic has 2 to 40 letters, numbers or _.
linhas.primeiraTexto: A feed is an open filter: where posts come from and what gets in. Build one from scratch or start from a ready-made one, just below.

regra.chamada: One rule, the same for everyone, written here and done in the database exactly as written. You can switch to order of arrival whenever you want.
regra.emRodaTexto: Order of arrival alone gets messy: someone who posts ten times in a row fills the screen, and tomorrow's call disappears under today's chat. In the circle, each person speaks in turn.

passos.texto: The top-level posts of the tab (or of the timeline you built), from the last {janela_dias} days, that you can see and have not muted. At most the {maximo} newest.
Up to {avisos} notices pinned by moderation, newest first.

passos.titulo: Then, the action that is near
passos.texto: Up to {atos} calls and actions dated within the next {perto_horas} hours, nearest first. A cancelled action does not go up.

passos.titulo: The rest, in blocks of {bloco_horas} hours
passos.texto: From the newest block to the oldest. Blocks start at 3 am, 9 am, 3 pm and 9 pm (Brasília time).

passos.titulo: Inside the block, first what you chose
passos.texto: If you answered the interests questionnaire, first come posts of a type you marked, with a #topic from your causes, from the study communities or from your groups. If you said you want more content, side conversations (a post that quotes another or calls someone by @, from people you don't follow, outside your communities and groups) move to the end of the block, without disappearing. Without the questionnaire, this step changes nothing.

passos.titulo: In each group, first whoever got help
passos.texto: First come the conversations where the person who asked marked an answer from someone else as the one that helped, and that got answers from {ajudou_piso} or more different people. It is a mark from the person who asked, not a count; in a conversation with fewer than {ajudou_piso} people answering, the mark does not change the order.
The newest post of each person; then the second of each person; and so on. In each round, newest first.
In each screen of {tela} posts, at most {teto} from the same person. What goes over the cap moves to the next screen, without losing its turn.

passos.titulo: The rule ends, order of arrival
passos.texto: Anything older than {janela_dias} days comes newest to oldest, with nothing else.

naoEntraLista: What you saved, clicked, opened or read, and for how long.
The time you come to the network.
Number of replies and number of followers.
Money: nobody pays to go up.
Who you are. Two people with the same choices see the same order.
regra.entra: What you choose that changes the timeline
entraLista: Who you follow, your communities and your cells.
What you muted: person, community, conversation or word.
The timelines you build, with the filter in plain sight.
The interests you marked in the questionnaire (only on your device).
regra.aparelho: What stays only on your device
regra.aparelhoTexto: The choice between In a circle and Order of arrival, the timelines you built, the questionnaire interests and the time of your last visit. The server keeps none of them: the interests go along with each read and are forgotten.
regra.repostes: Reposts from people you follow only appear in Order of arrival.
regra.deFora: In the Following tab, people you follow on the Fediverse join the round as one more person: each of their posts goes into the 6-hour block in which it was written, after the highlights.
regra.altaTexto: #topics used by {alta_piso} or more different people in the last {alta_horas} hours, and by more people than in the {alta_horas} hours before. Only posts every member can see count. Up to {alta_maximo} topics, the one that grew most first; ties, alphabetical order. The list is the same for everyone and shows no number. Moderation can remove a topic from the list (a person's name, an insult, an attack campaign); the topic still exists.
regra.foraTexto: It appears when you come back after 8 hours or more (24 or 4 hours, if you chose another pace in the questionnaire). It shows the first {fora_destaques} posts by the same rule, only with what arrived after your last visit.
regra.respostasTexto: You choose: oldest, newest, useful or unanswered. In "useful", the reply the asker marked as the one that helped comes first, then those marked useful by 3 or more people; a mark from 1 or 2 people changes nothing. In "unanswered", replies nobody has answered yet come first. Whoever opened the conversation can take a reply out of the thread without deleting it: it stays behind "hidden replies", which anyone can open.
regra.provaTexto: The rule is open source. The test that runs on every change proves that the same input gives the same order to two people with the same choices, and that liking, saving or replying does not change the order. It also proves that, without interests, the order is exactly the same as before, and that the interests are not stored anywhere.

conversa.regraUteis: First the reply that helped the asker; then those marked useful by 3 or more people.
conversa.regraSemResposta: First the replies nobody has answered yet.
conversa.ocultada: Reply hidden. It was not deleted, and nobody was notified.
conversa.ocultadasUma: 1 reply hidden by whoever opened the conversation
conversa.ocultadas: {n} replies hidden by whoever opened the conversation
conversa.ocultadasRegra: Whoever opened the conversation took these replies out of the thread. They were not deleted.

interesses.texto: The questionnaire stays only on this device. See what you marked, change it or delete it in Settings.
